text:
Ivy R.: Incoming DPA + security questionnaire from Novus Health. They asked for SOC2 Type II cert + controls mapping, a simplified dataflow PNG, KMS provenance/BYOK proof, embeddings retention & deletion SOP, and 90-day redacted access logs. Renewal window = 6 weeks. Who can own the evidence bundle?
Mateo (CS): I can take point on this. Quick Q: do they want the full SOC2 report or cert + mapping only?
Priya (Legal): Provide cert + controls mapping only. If they insist on the full report, require an executed NDA and purpose limitation.
Anika (Security): Note: Hosted accounts do NOT support customer-supplied key material. We'll prepare a formal attestation explaining cloud-provider CMKs for Hosted and BYOK/HSM for Dedicated/private. I'll draft the attestation.
Rohan (Infra): I can pull logs for tenant novus-221 but need explicit tenant identifier and redaction scope. Redaction must follow playbook. ETA for redacted bundle: 48-72h.
Mateo (CS): Plan: 1) create Drive folder + upload SOC2 cert; 2) assemble control mapping CSV; 3) export simplified dataflow PNG; 4) include KMS attestation draft from Anika; 5) add embeddings retention & deletion SOP; 6) request redacted access logs from Rohan. Target internal review in 48h, send to customer in 72h.
cs-bot: Ticket CS-6001 created: "Novus DPA intake" assigned to Mateo (CS) - due in 3 business days.
sec-bot: Reminder: follow redaction playbook: https://confluence.redwood/security/redaction and attach a redaction manifest.
Priya (Legal): Also redact internal ticket IDs and do not include raw vulnerability scan outputs. Keep cover note clear about limitations.
Ivy R.: Flagging renewal risk = medium-high if BYOK is non-negotiable. Mateo, escalate to Sales/Solutions Eng if customer pushes BYOK. :warning:
Mateo (CS): Will do. I'll post the Drive link here once artifacts are uploaded and loop Legal/Security for sign-off. :thumbsup:
